mechanism: Cobicistat is a potent CYP3A4 inhibitor that significantly increases cenobamate plasma concentrations, while cenobamate induces CYP3A4 and may reduce cobicistat/antiretroviral efficacy.
action: Avoid concomitant use or monitor cenobamate levels closely with dose adjustment if coadministration is necessary; cobicistat-boosted antiretroviral regimen efficacy may be compromised.
